title: Hold an activity licence for a licensable public health risk activity
what: Carry on a licensable public health risk activity only under an activity licence (or as accredited under an activity accreditation scheme, s 22).

sources.title: Public Health Act 1997 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 21(1) (current republication (R45, from 26 November 2025; Public Health Act 1997 | Acts))
sources.quote: A person must not carry on a licensable public health risk activity unless the person— (a) holds an activity licence for the activity
